title: eat, shit & die 269
author: bpatrick
body: Holy shit! I didn’t realize how carried away I had gotten with this one until comicpress made me split into thirds and all three pieces are still long as hell. This one’s in three parts so make sure you click all the way through. This started out as a regular ol’ comic but then I thought about adding what the characters were thinking about while they talked about what they talk about. Then it got out of hand. Turned out to only have room for Trent’s side and that is still too long.
